newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO GROUND TO BE RELAID FOR EUROPEAN CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO GROUND TO BE RELAID FOR EUROPEAN CLASH.

text.p: Atletico Madrid announced on Tuesday the turf at their Vicente Calderon ground is to be relaid barely a week before their first Champions League fixture with Steaua Bucharest.

The Spanish club had to move the opening game of the new season to the Santiago Bernabeu stadium of rivals Real Madrid after an invasion of worms at the beginning of August made their own pitch unplayable.
